dog.description_text: Bumble is an 8 week old female Great Dane/Lab mix with the sweetest, gentlest demeanor, plenty of hearts to steal, and some big paws to grow into! According to information provided by the shelter, her mom was a purebred Great Dane. Since arriving from our shelter partner, Bumble has been loving life in her foster home and settling in beautifully. A little shy at first, Bumble is slowly discovering her brave side, and the silly, playful puppy underneath is well worth the wait. Her daily agenda? Eat, pounce on a toy, practice her zoomies, and curl up with her chin resting on whichever part of you is available. She’s making progress with her puppy-pad and crate training, mostly sleeping through the night, and already offering little paw hellos. With a Great Dane mama, Bumble has plenty of growing ahead of he, but she’s getting an early start on being a lap dog. Help this little blossom put down roots. Apply to adopt Bumble at rescuecity.nyc!
dog.name: Bumble
